teaching.description: Twaniriye kuvya babamalayika indwi Yohana yerekwa akabona bahabwa inzamba ndwi . Twararabiye hamwe ivyo Yohana yabonye nivyo yumvise bijanye nuko ba bamalayika bavugije izo nzamba. Twarangije twumvise ivyago bikurikiranye nuko abamalayika bane bavugije inzamba zabo.

content: Kuko, ko Imana itagiriye ikigongwe abamarayika bakoze ivyaha, ariko ikabakororera i kuzimu, ikabashira mu vyobo vy'umwiza, ngo babikirwe gutsindwa n'urubanza;

teaching.description: Twarumvise ko abigisha b'ibinyoma bakoreshwa n'ukwipfuza inyungu kwabo kandi ngo gucirirwa kw'iteka kwabo uhereye kera ntiguteba no guhona kwabo ntiguhunyiza. Ubuheruka rero niho twarabira hamwe uturorero twabaciriweko iteka n'Imana bo mw'isi yo hambere. Utwo turorero nitwo twutu:1. (2 Petero 2:4 )ivy'abamalayika bakoze ivyaha mu kugarariza Imana bifanije na Satani, Imana nayo ikabarorera mu vyobo vy'umwiza ngo barindigwe kuzocirwa kw'iteka. 2. (2 Petero 2 : 5 ) ivy'ugucigwa kw'iteka y'isi yo mugihe ca Nowa. Iyo si ya kera n'isi y'ubwambere imbere ya Nowa. Ico gihe ivyaha vyari vyarabaye umurengera mu bantu bopse kiretse Nowa yari acubaha Imana. 3. (2 Petero 2 : 6 ) Ivy'ugucirwa kw'iteka kw'abantu bo mu bisagara vy'I Sodomu ni Gomora. Ivyaha vy'I Sodomu ni Gomora vy'ubusambanyi bw'agahomera bunwa nibwo bwatumye Imana irandura ivyo bisagara. Cabaye ikimenyamenya ko abatubaha Imana bose bashobora kuba mu gihano nk'iki c'ab'i Sodomu n'i Gomora babayemwo.

Abo nibo Petero yise abacokoranyi kandi ni ba bandi bitwa abigisha b'ibinyoma. Twibuke yuko abigisha b'ibinyoma ataruko boba bayobewe ukuri ariko babigira ibigirankana kubera inyungu zabo mbi bironderera.
teaching.name: Ivy'ukugaruka kwa Kristo

content: Umwami Imana ntitebeje isezerano ryayo, uko bamwe biyumvira ko iritevya. Ariko yihanganira mwebwe, ntigomba ko hagira abahona, ariko igomba ko bose bihana.

teaching.description: Twarangije inyigisho z'icete ca kabiri ca Petero aduhamagarira kurereka ijuru risha n'isi nsha .Isi yubu izocirwa kw'Iteka , ibiri muriyo vyose bigashongeshwa n'ikibengebenge c'umuriro. Ariko naho bizoshongeshwa si ukuvuga yuko ivy'isi n'ijuru bizoba bihereye ngaho. Petero yarangije kino cete atazira Umwami w'abami ariwe Yesu Kristo. Tugire umwete wo gukurira mu buntu bwa Kristo.
teaching.name: Ugushonga kw' isi

content: Mwiyumvire yuko kwihangana kw'Umwami wacu ari agakiza; nk'uko umuvukanyi akundwa Pahulo yabandikiye, uko ubwenge yahawe bungana.
